channel.title: 1000 Errors: Laser Cut Art & Light Sculptures
channel.description: Laser Cut Art & Light Sculptures by 1000 Errors.

item.title: Hexstatic LED Light Sculpture, Flower of Life Wood Mandala
item.description: Hexstatic wooden mandala LED light sculpture glowing warm white. Flower of Life inspired mandala in hexagon layers, laser cut from birch, hand painted and lit with adjustable LEDs. 35–70cm. Made in Bristol, UK. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.

item.title: Platonic Energy Circle, LED Sacred Geometry Wall Mandala
item.description: Platonic Energy Circle wooden mandala LED wall light sculpture glowing red. Three-layer laser cut birch wall mandala featuring the five platonic solids, with colour-changing LED lighting. 60cm or 89cm. Made in Bristol, UK. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.

item.title: Sacred Geometry Christmas Ornaments, Laser Cut Birch Set of 10
item.description: Set of laser cut wooden sacred geometry Christmas tree ornaments laid out around a star. Ten laser cut and engraved birch Christmas tree ornaments: a 20cm star plus nine 6.5cm sacred geometry pieces. Made in Bristol, UK. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.

item.title: Quintessence LED Light Sculpture, 5-Layer Wood Mandala
item.description: Quintessence laser cut wooden mandala light sculpture glowing purple. Five-fold sacred geometry light sculpture in 5 layers of laser cut wood, with colour-changing LEDs and a stand. Numbered first run. Made in Bristol, UK. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.

item.title: Seed of Life LED Light Sculpture, Laser Cut Birch Mandala
item.description: Seed of Life wooden LED light sculpture hanging on a wooden wall above a sofa. Seed of Life sacred geometry light sculpture, laser cut from layered birch and hand painted, with adjustable LED lighting. 30–80cm. Made in Bristol, UK. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.

item.title: Septagram LED Light Sculpture, Laser Cut Wood Mandala
item.description: Septagram laser cut wooden light sculpture glowing red on a sideboard. Seven-pointed septagram light sculpture in 7 layers of laser cut wood, LED-lit, with a stand and wall hanging ring. 30–80cm. Made in Bristol, UK. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.

item.title: Laser Cut Eurorack Case Design
item.description: A standalone, parametric app for designing curved Eurorack cases for modular synthesizers, with native exports for CNC and laser cutting. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.
